headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2020, Omega & Page vs. The Lucha Brothers went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.93 ? a war that left everything in the ring. A tag team showcase on the same loaded card as Cody's steel cage spectacle ? the champions closed things out with their signature Buckshot Lariat/V-Trigger combo, setting up a Revolution rematch against the Young Bucks after a chaotic tag battle royal.
2025 brought us this moment: Orange Cassidy vs. Roderick Strong met in a Number One Contender, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.05 ? a strong outing.

Back on this day in 2020, Wardlow announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance in a Steel Cage match against Cody, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.03 ? a fantastic contest. Wardlow's in-ring debut, thrown right into a steel cage ? Cody capped a chaotic match involving MJF and a stolen diamond ring by climbing to the top of the cage and hitting a moonsault to win, a jaw-dropping spot that fans still bring up

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2020, when Alex Reynolds made their first appearance under the AEW banner in a Battle Royal match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.95.
2020 brought us this moment: Jeff Cobb competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Jon Moxley, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.86.
On this day in 2025, after 3 matches, Hook, Joe & Shibata debuted a bold new identity: The Opps (Hook, Joe & Shibata), on Dynamite.
